snippet.title: Dominus Automa - Steam Multiplayer Playtest | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Join the Playtest now at - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3795810/Dominus_Automa/
Join the community at - https://discord.gg/VCQ2gbA4XG

#rpg #gametrailers #indiegame #playtest 

Starting today, thousands of adventurers from across the globe enter the Dominus Automa Playtest to explore a persistent online world filled with PvE, PvP, boss encounters, crafting, exploration and rewarding progression - with you among them!

Dominus Automa is an Idle Open World RPG meant for busy adults who still love online gaming but don't have endless hours to play anymore. Shape your hero's decision-making process, define their strategy with the Combat Matrix system, and let them progress 24/7 - even when you're offline. The Playtest, being a fairly early version of the game, is primarily focused on testing its core systems, while offering you:

• 14 days of open Playtest
• 25 levels to achieve
• 10 locations to explore
• new Paladin class
• nearly 20 enemies and 3 bosses to slay

From the very beginning, we've designed Dominus Automa around one simple idea: your gaming schedule should never dictate your progress. Play whenever it suits you, enjoy the game at your own pace, and never worry about falling behind or a FOMO feeling. Using the Combat Matrix system, you'll define exactly how your hero behaves in battle. No two champions fight alike. No two players have the same approach. No two encounters are identical - whether solo or in a group, in a PvP or PvE scenario.

The Paladin, a brand-new playable class, is now available, standing by the Mage's side. With the arrival of this mighty Tank, we're one step closer to completing the genre's legendary holy trinity: Tank, Healer, and Damage Dealer. 

See you online!
